title: TICWATCH PRO ESSENTIAL MODE
body: Is there any change to get at Ticwatch Pro at essential mode readings from Xdrip? This would be great for battery life.

comments.body: Hello, I think the Essential mode activate the LCD display and it is an hardware watchface and I'm not sure but I think that the BT is off also so.... battery life is saved but... hélas ;) :)
I have the TicWatch Pro, essential mode just turns it into a dumb watch, so not possible to show custom numbers on the LCD. I wish we could, though :(

@dimis28 Would you please ask your questions using the support channels?
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
If you have done your research and you are sure there is no work-around, and if you feel it is a critical feature that would benefit many users, you can open an issue as a feature request.
Thanks
